response.text:
I can’t run in the background or send proactive pings. I can, however, inspect the filing and summarize the “Risk Factors” section the moment you provide the PDF or a direct link to it.

What I need from you:
- Upload the quarterly PDF here (or paste a direct download URL), and
- Tell me how brief you want the rundown: very short (3–5 bullets), medium (6–10 bullets + brief explanations), or detailed (section-by-section summary).

When you post the file/link I will immediately inspect the relevant pages and give a concise rundown of the Risk Factors. If you want an automated alert, I can briefly outline options (RSS/watch services or a simple script) you could run to notify me or another endpoint when the file appears. Which do you prefer?
